feedback: Approve. This is the final iteration, so the candidate is kept as the most reliable raced design. It matches iteration 9 (score 432.15, the best raced): sensors at x = -0.05, -0.025, 0, 0.025, 0.05 with y = 0.07, sensor_size 0.012, kp 1.8, ki 0.5, kd 0.4, base_speed 1.2, last_direction. Iteration 9 was the only design that combined a reliable oval finish with the best s-bend progress. Iteration 10 (x spread ±0.04) lost oval finishes and tight-track progress, and iteration 4 (±0.07) and iteration 6 (sensor_size 0.016) both hurt, so none of those are reintroduced. Untested tweaks (kd 0.5, kp 2.0) have no race evidence, and the unseen track is scored once with no later check, so changing them now is an unmeasured risk. The Optimizer should ship this design unchanged.
requested_changes: Ship the iteration 9 design unchanged: controller.kp 1.8, kd 0.4, ki 0.5, base_speed 1.2, line_loss last_direction, sensor y 0.07, x -0.05 to 0.05, sensor_size 0.012. Iteration 9 is the best raced score (432.15) and the only design finishing the oval 20 of 20 while raising s-bend progress to 0.68.
Do not narrow the x spread to ±0.04 or widen it to ±0.07, and do not change sensor_size to 0.016 or base_speed to 1.0. Iterations 4, 6, 8 and 10 each lowered the score against iteration 9.
